newsitem.title: UK: BT seen sharply lower after MCI warning.
newsitem.headline: BT seen sharply lower after MCI warning.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc are expected to fall sharply in early trading with dealers saying the price will be about 35p weaker at 442p a share after a profit warning from merger partner MCI.
BT said late last night that it is in talks with MCI Communications Corp on the change in outlook on the group's results but that it would not have an impact on the planned merger.
Analysts are expecting to downgrade BT profit forecasts today.
Mike Stiles at Credit Lyonnais Laing says his forecast for the year to March 1999 will go down to nearer four billion stg from the current 4.35 billion.
"We are looking for ten percent below what we thought before and so it is logical to knock the shares down ten percent," Stiles said.
Analysts said the key thing is to watch was what MCI shares do on Friday as the statement came out after New York trading hours.
They said the alliance deal looked like it was going to have to be renegotiated.

"It won't look too clever if they pay $20 billion for a company that won't be making much more than a billion dollars in 1998/99 with the possibility of further losses if they try to break into the local loop," Stiles said.
